name: smart-enter-and-backspace
description: Language-agnostic smart Enter (brace expansion, block-header braces, control-flow indentation) and smart Backspace (pair delete, indent collapse, blank-line join). Indentation-based languages get nearest-indent backspace and never see brace styles.

smartEnterAndBackspace.smartEnter.description: Smart Enter: expand {|}, add braces after block headers, indent after control-flow headers, insert missing semicolons. Indentation-based languages are left to the editor's native auto-indent.

smartEnterAndBackspace.braceExpansion.description: Expand an empty {} pair into a multi-line block when pressing Enter between the braces.

smartEnterAndBackspace.braceStyle.description: Brace style for blocks this extension generates. inherit follows the current file. Ignored entirely in indentation-based languages.

smartEnterAndBackspace.smartSemicolon.description: Insert a missing ; when pressing Enter at the end of an unclosed statement (languages that use semicolons only).

smartEnterAndBackspace.smartSurroundWith.description: Wrap a selection in a brace block when typing {, and merge a block typed below an unbraced control-flow header into that header.

smartEnterAndBackspace.smartBackspace.description: Smart Backspace: collapse interior whitespace in empty pairs, delete empty pairs in one stroke, collapse leading indentation, and erase whitespace-only lines.

smartEnterAndBackspace.backspace.uninden.description: How Backspace collapses leading indentation: toTabstop (previous tab stop), toUnindent (previous non-blank line's indent), toProper (join to previous line), none (native).

smartEnterAndBackspace.backspace.indente.description: In indentation-based languages (Python, YAML, Ruby, F#, ...) always collapse leading indentation to the nearest surrounding indent, ignoring brace-oriented modes.

smartEnterAndBackspace.overtype.description: Typing a closer that already sits right after the caret steps over it instead of duplicating it (e.g. typing ) before an existing )). Also steps inside when typing an opener directly before its own empty pair.

smartEnterAndBackspace.verboseLogging.description: Log each Smart Enter / Smart Backspace decision to the Smart Enter And Backspace output channel.
